name: KEY MD
description: KEY MD - Modular Telegram group management bot. All original Rose features preserved.

ENV.description: Setting this to ANYTHING will enable env variables

TOKEN.description: Your bot token, as a string.

OWNER_ID.description: An integer of consisting of your owner ID

WEBHOOK.description: Setting this to ANYTHING will enable webhooks when in env mode

URL.description: The App URL similar to https://<appname>.vercel.app/ or Heroku URL

MESSAGE_DUMP.description: optional: a chat where your replied saved messages are stored

SUDO_USERS.description: A space separated list of user_ids which should be considered sudo users

SUPPORT_USERS.description: A space separated list of user_ids which should be considered support users

WHITELIST_USERS.description: A space separated list of user_ids which should be considered whitelisted

DONATION_LINK.description: Optional: link where you would like to receive donations.

PORT.description: Port to use for your webhooks

DEL_CMDS.description: Whether to delete commands from users which don't have rights to use that command

STRICT_GBAN.description: Enforce gbans across new groups as well as old groups.

ALLOW_EXCL.description: Whether to allow using exclamation marks ! for commands as well as /.

BAN_STICKER.description: Which sticker to use when banning people.
